annotations.title: Send a notice to a group of pass holders (hosts and organizers only)

description: Sends a notice from the organizer of an event, or a host of a personal event, to the people who added the event pass to their Wallet. Needs a personal connector token, `eventIdOrName`, `audience` and `text`. It shows on their lock screen and stays on the pass. `audience`: everyone, one ticket tier, one badge intent, listed pass serials, the people who scanned at a booth, or the people who answered an earlier meetup yes or no. A meetup with a place is event_meetup_announce. Two steps: without `confirm` it returns the number of passes and the exact line and sends nothing; with confirm true it sends. sendAt schedules the notice for a later time before the event ends, one scheduled notice per event; without it the notice sends now. Only the hosts or the organizer can send; anybody else is refused. "my_booth" returns VENDOR_OFF. Six an hour per event, then RATE_LIMITED. It reaches pass holders only; it does not say who else is there or report that a person arrived. Always call once without confirm and read the preview to the person; set confirm true only on the call after they say yes.

audience.description: everyone, tier, intent, serials, booth, meetup_yes or meetup_no.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

requestId.description: Optional caller id; one id sends once.

sendAt.description: Optional: when to send instead of now, as a full timestamp with a time zone (2027-06-12T09:00:00-07:00) or plain words such as tomorrow 9am, read in the event's time zone. It must be in the future and before the event ends. One scheduled notice per event; to remove it, use event_pass_notice_cancel.

text.description: One plain line, up to 120 characters.
